description: Target U-values per envelope element for Ireland, used by decision Q11 to size an insulation layer whose thickness a request does not state: the thickness is the smallest 10 mm step that brings the element from its current U-value to the target. Every row is PROVISIONAL and has to be checked against the current revision of the Technical Guidance Document before a result leaves a laboratory.
